title: Customer Roadmap Triage Horizon for Enterprise Signal Validation
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: Define and pilot a deterministic 'Horizon' for customer-driven roadmap acceptance that validates enterprise signals (MRR, renewal risk, compliance blockers, and strategic alignment) and produces a graded commitment (soft commit / scoped runway / blocked). Background: We have many high-touch asks from strategic accounts that bypass the standard intake queue, making roadmap promises ambiguous and burning team capacity. This initiative creates a repeatable rubric, automation hooks, and communication templates to reduce ambiguity, accelerate decisions, and surface risky asks earlier. Scope: 1) Signal schema and weighting (MRR, renewal proximity, regulatory blocker, integration effort, product fit). 2) Acceptance gates tied to commitment levels (Info / Soft Commit / Scoped Deliverable / Blocked). 3) Slack + CRM triage automation for account advocates. 4) Single-page intake UI for PM console + Confluence templates. 5) Pilot with 6 enterprise accounts over 6 weeks. Out of scope: full contract renegotiation workflow, Dedicated capacity procurement SLA changes. Success metrics: - Reduction in open high-touch asks older than 30 days by 40% within pilot. - Time-to-decision median < 7 days for triaged escalations. - Percent of accepted asks with explicit commitment level >= 90%. Key stakeholders: PMs (enterprise), Solutions Engineering, Sales/Evangelism, Customer Success, Legal (for compliance blockers), Eng reliability lead. Acceptance criteria: - Published rubric + scoring spreadsheet. - Automation configured in Intake Slack channel and CRM tags. - Pilot runbook and retrospective documented. - One PRD and one Confluence intake template published. Rollout plan: 1) Draft rubric and scoring (week 1). 2) Build intake UI + Slack/CRM automation (week 2-3). 3) Run pilot with 6 accounts and weekly score reviews (week 4-9). 4) Retro + recommend org-level policy (week 10). Risks: - Sales pushes for escalated timelines outside rubric; mitigation: communication playbook + escalation guardrails. - Inaccurate signal mapping for niche verticals; mitigation: include account-level override with required rationale. Dependencies: CRM tagging support, Solutions Engineering time for pilot Q&A, Legal for compliance blocker definitions. Open questions: - Should we include a revenue uplift proxy (deal expansion probability) as an input? - What SLA should we require for Engineering feasibility review? - Does top-of-funnel intake live in Console or in Confluence first?
